clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says 99% of the motivational speakers on YouTube never built anything.

They went to school, never started a company, never made real money - then wrote a book teaching "success."

A guy wrote him asking to endorse his new book on the billionaire mindset. His day job? Driving a UPS truck.

Kevin only trusted the ones who had actually done it: Ed Foreman made hundreds of millions before he ever gave a speech.

Before you take advice from anyone, ask one question: have they done the thing, or just read about it?

#kevintrudeau #success #mindset #business #motivation #wealth

Kevin Trudeau says the habit that trained his mind for success was almost embarrassingly simple.

Every morning at 5am, a timer clicked on a cassette player by his bed - a motivational speaker playing while he was still half asleep.

He carried that tape everywhere: the shower, the car, the kitchen. Some tapes he played dozens of times, on purpose, spaced repetition.

His circle didn't measure distance in miles. They measured it in tapes: a two tape drive, a six tape drive.

What are you feeding your mind the other 23 hours of the day?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #success #discipline #motivation #selfimprovement

Kevin Trudeau says there's one element behind every success story nobody talks about.

Diplomas, trophies, medals, Academy Awards - Kevin says recognition is wired into every successful person's life, given as much as received.

But the real glue, he says, is relationships. Not just connections, a real romantic partner.

The old saying was "behind every successful man is a great woman." Kevin flips it: behind every successful person is a great partner, full stop.

Who is your person, the one who makes the rest of it possible?

#kevintrudeau #success #relationships #mindset #motivation #partnership
